answer.summary: The front-end build inside the Docker image failed during yarn build with 'Build failed with 7 errors' (rolldown/vite). The actual error messages are elided from the excerpt, so the specific cause is not shown. The change adds and edits many front-end graph files, which makes a deterministic compile or bundling error from this change the most likely cause. A re-run would probably fail the same way. Check the 7 errors in the full log (lines 1403-1493) to confirm.

evidence.quote: #24 ERROR: process "/bin/sh -c set -eux                             ; npm install -g corepack                  ; yarn install                             ; yarn build                               ;" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
